hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.subtitle: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using the Sky Galaxy website or making a purchase — they govern the relationship between you and the company.

sections.title: Return Policy
paragraphs: Returns of sold materials are not accepted after 15 days from the invoice date. Items must be in their original packaging or containers and in good condition suitable for resale, and are subject to inspection by our factories' quality department.

No product that has been used or opened by the customer may be returned. If a return is accepted, 15% of the original goods' value is deducted to cover handling, repackaging, and return-shipping costs to the main warehouses.
list: To request a return, send us: the invoice number, date, and total value
The amount requested for refund, the product name to be returned, and the reason for the return
Allow 72 hours (excluding official and weekly holidays) for a customer service representative to contact you to arrange a time and place for product pickup, inspection, and refund
